I.e. mint should return the same or fewer assets as previewMint if called in the   same transaction. - MUST NOT account for mint limits like those returned from maxMint and should always act as though the mint   would be accepted, regardless if the user has enough tokens approved, etc. - MUST be inclusive of deposit fees. Integrators should be aware of the existence of deposit fees. - MUST NOT revert. NOTE: any unfavorable discrepancy between convertToAssets and previewMint SHOULD be considered slippage in share price or some other type of condition, meaning the depositor will lose assets by minting.

previewRedeem(uint256).details: Allows an on-chain or off-chain user to simulate the effects of their redeemption at the current block, given current on-chain conditions. - MUST return as close to and no more than the exact amount of assets that would be withdrawn in a redeem call   in the same transaction. I.e. redeem should return the same or more assets as previewRedeem if called in the   same transaction. - MUST NOT account for redemption limits like those returned from maxRedeem and should always act as though the   redemption would be accepted, regardless if the user has enough shares, etc. - MUST be inclusive of withdrawal fees. Integrators should be aware of the existence of withdrawal fees. - MUST NOT revert. NOTE: any unfavorable discrepancy between convertToAssets and previewRedeem SHOULD be considered slippage in share price or some other type of condition, meaning the depositor will lose assets by redeeming.

previewWithdraw(uint256).details: Allows an on-chain or off-chain user to simulate the effects of their withdrawal at the current block, given current on-chain conditions. - MUST return as close to and no fewer than the exact amount of Vault shares that would be burned in a withdraw   call in the same transaction. I.e. withdraw should return the same or fewer shares as previewWithdraw if   called   in the same transaction. - MUST NOT account for withdrawal limits like those returned from maxWithdraw and should always act as though   the withdrawal would be accepted, regardless if the user has enough shares, etc. - MUST be inclusive of withdrawal fees. Integrators should be aware of the existence of withdrawal fees. - MUST NOT revert. NOTE: any unfavorable discrepancy between convertToShares and previewWithdraw SHOULD be considered slippage in share price or some other type of condition, meaning the depositor will lose assets by depositing.

redeem(uint256,address,address).details: Burns exactly shares from owner and sends assets of underlying tokens to receiver. - MUST emit the Withdraw event. - MAY support an additional flow in which the underlying tokens are owned by the Vault contract before the   redeem execution, and are accounted for during redeem. - MUST revert if all of shares cannot be redeemed (due to withdrawal limit being reached, slippage, the owner   not having enough shares, etc). NOTE: some implementations will require pre-requesting to the Vault before a withdrawal may be performed. Those methods should be performed separately.

approveTransform(uint256,address,bool).notice: Allows another address to call transform on behalf of owner (on a given token)

borrow(uint256,uint256).notice: Borrows specified amount using token as collateral

create(uint256,address).notice: Creates a new collateralized position (transfer approved position)

createWithPermit(uint256,address,uint256.notice: Creates a new collateralized position with a permit for token spending (transfer position with permit)

lendInfo(address).notice: Retrieves lending information for a specified account.

liquidate((uint256,uint256,uint256,addre.notice: Liquidates position - needed assets are depending on current price. Sufficient assets need to be approved to the contract for the liquidation to succeed.

loanAtIndex(address,uint256).notice: Retrieves tokenid of loan at given index for owner (for enumerating owners loans)

loanCount(address).notice: Retrieves count of loans for owner (for enumerating owners loans)

loanInfo(uint256).notice: Retrieves details of a loan identified by its token ID.

onERC721Received(address,address,uint256.notice: Whenever a token is recieved it either creates a new loan, or modifies an existing one when in transform mode.

remove(uint256,address,bytes).notice: Removes position from the vault (only possible when all repayed)

repay(uint256,uint256,bool).notice: Repays borrowed tokens. Can be denominated in assets or debt share amount

repay(uint256,uint256,bool,bytes).notice: Repays borrowed tokens. Can be denominated in assets or debt share amount

setLimits(uint256,uint256,uint256,uint25.notice: set limits (this doesnt affect existing loans) - this method can be called by owner OR emergencyAdmin

setReserveFactor(uint32).notice: sets reserve factor - percentage difference between debt and lend interest (onlyOwner)

setReserveProtectionFactor(uint32).notice: sets reserve protection factor - percentage of globalLendAmount which can't be withdrawn by owner (onlyOwner)

setTokenConfig(address,uint32,uint32).notice: Sets or updates the configuration for a token (onlyOwner)

transform(uint256,address,bytes).notice: Method which allows a contract to transform a loan by changing it (and only at the end checking collateral)

vaultInfo().notice: Retrieves global information about the vault

withdrawReserves(uint256,address).notice: withdraw protocol reserves (onlyOwner) only allows to withdraw excess reserves (> globalLendAmount * reserveProtectionFactor)

userdoc.notice: The vault manages ONE ERC20 (eg. USDC) asset for lending / borrowing, but collateral positions can be composed of any 2 tokens configured each with a collateralFactor > 0 Vault implements IERC4626 Vault Standard and is itself a ERC20 which represent shares of total lending pool

warnings: Static deployment/source/ABI inventory only; no current runtime identity, balance, liquidity, funding, successful execution, complete workflow or financial-safety guarantee. Zero native value; independent grants, pauses, canonical calldata and transaction controls remain mandatory.

Arbitrum native USDC 0xaf88d065e77c8cC2239327C5EDb3A432268e5831 is the immutable asset, with 6 decimals; rlUSDC share base units also use 6 decimals. This is not bridged USDC.e, raw ETH, an NFT receipt or debt shares.

Plain deposit/mint pull USDC atomically from msg.sender using existing allowance to V3Vault and mint rlUSDC to receiver; they pass empty permitData internally. Permit2 overloads and all signature authorization entries are excluded. No standalone prefunding capability.

Conversions update accrued interest first. Deposit floors shares, mint rounds required USDC up; redeem floors USDC, withdraw rounds shares up. In this exact V3Vault implementation a withdrawal/redeem request exceeding owner share balance is clipped to that balance and recalculates assets, so requested exact assets may not be delivered. No caller minimum output, maximum input or deadline.

Withdraw/redeem burn owner shares; a different msg.sender requires pre-existing share allowance from owner. USDC goes to caller-chosen receiver. Exits require idle USDC and revert InsufficientLiquidity when insufficient; no withdrawal queue or fixed exit delay is provided.

Owner or emergencyAdmin can change global and daily lending/debt limits; zero or restrictive lending limits can block entry. Daily lending limit resets on UTC day number and exits replenish it. No current limits or perpetual unpaused availability are attested; this direct source has no separate lender pause flag.

Lenders fund loans against allowed Uniswap V3 LP NFT collateral, subject to oracle values, collateral/debt limits, minimum loan sizes, health checks and liquidations. Uncovered liquidation shortfalls can lower the lending exchange rate pro rata; reserve-factor interest deductions and dependencies affect conversions. No loan, collateral transformer, liquidation, arbitrary multicall or NFT callback surface is admitted.

ABI functions do not establish website, legal, jurisdictional or account eligibility; any applicable protocol and independent policy restrictions remain binding. No KYC clearance or asset-safety assertion.

sourceSemantics.mutableState: Source initial lending/debt exchange rates are Q96; source initial global limits are zero until configured. No current storage limits/rates or pause snapshot was fetched. Do not substitute initial configuration for current configuration. V3Vault source has no fallback delegate proxy or upgrade entry; dependencies and admin risk parameters remain effective.
sourceSemantics.collateral: Underlying borrower collateral is configured Uniswap V3 LP NFT. Lending shares are not collateral/debt shares. Borrower owner checks, oracle collateral factors, safety buffers, loan minima and liquidations are preserved in full source but no borrower execution capability is selected.
sourceSemantics.fees: No explicit ordinary deposit/withdraw fee charged in these selected bodies. Interest supply rate deducts mutable reserveFactorX32; uncovered bad debt can decrease lastLendExchangeRateX96. This is not a promise of a positive or lossless exchange rate.

lifecycleEvidence.excerpt: If most of the pool is currently borrowed, there may not be enough idle liquidity to fill your full withdrawal immediately. The protocol does not pretend otherwise, and it does not guarantee instant exit at high utilization.

lifecycleEvidence.excerpt: The V3Vault contract allows users to deposit a specific ERC20 token (e.g., USDC) to earn interest or borrow against their LP positions.

lifecycleConclusion: Current primary Revert Lend lending and withdrawal guides plus current official exact Arbitrum V3Vault deployment listing describe an available lending product, not an exit-only or retirement guide. No shutdown inferred from liquidity constraints or restricted instantaneous withdrawals.
limitations: Static deployment/source/ABI inventory only; no current runtime identity, balance, liquidity, funding, successful execution, complete workflow or financial-safety guarantee. Zero native value; independent grants, pauses, canonical calldata and transaction controls remain mandatory.

Arbitrum native USDC 0xaf88d065e77c8cC2239327C5EDb3A432268e5831 is the immutable asset, with 6 decimals; rlUSDC share base units also use 6 decimals. This is not bridged USDC.e, raw ETH, an NFT receipt or debt shares.

Plain deposit/mint pull USDC atomically from msg.sender using existing allowance to V3Vault and mint rlUSDC to receiver; they pass empty permitData internally. Permit2 overloads and all signature authorization entries are excluded. No standalone prefunding capability.

Conversions update accrued interest first. Deposit floors shares, mint rounds required USDC up; redeem floors USDC, withdraw rounds shares up. In this exact V3Vault implementation a withdrawal/redeem request exceeding owner share balance is clipped to that balance and recalculates assets, so requested exact assets may not be delivered. No caller minimum output, maximum input or deadline.

Withdraw/redeem burn owner shares; a different msg.sender requires pre-existing share allowance from owner. USDC goes to caller-chosen receiver. Exits require idle USDC and revert InsufficientLiquidity when insufficient; no withdrawal queue or fixed exit delay is provided.

Owner or emergencyAdmin can change global and daily lending/debt limits; zero or restrictive lending limits can block entry. Daily lending limit resets on UTC day number and exits replenish it. No current limits or perpetual unpaused availability are attested; this direct source has no separate lender pause flag.

Lenders fund loans against allowed Uniswap V3 LP NFT collateral, subject to oracle values, collateral/debt limits, minimum loan sizes, health checks and liquidations. Uncovered liquidation shortfalls can lower the lending exchange rate pro rata; reserve-factor interest deductions and dependencies affect conversions. No loan, collateral transformer, liquidation, arbitrary multicall or NFT callback surface is admitted.

ABI functions do not establish website, legal, jurisdictional or account eligibility; any applicable protocol and independent policy restrictions remain binding. No KYC clearance or asset-safety assertion.
